title: Report HTTP resources
responsibility: Serves site-scoped report identity and registered evidence or export files.

inputs.name: reportFile.id
inputs.description: Report identifier loaded through the site repository.

inputs.name: reportFile.type
inputs.description: Requested file group; only assets and exports are supported.

inputs.name: reportFile.file
inputs.description: Requested registered evidence or export filename.

outputs.name: repository
outputs.description: Site-scoped report repository shared by these handlers.

outputs.name: reportHttp
outputs.description: JSON identity response with app/version, actual build identity, optional verification revision and a hash of the repository root.

outputs.name: reportFile
outputs.description: Promise resolving to local or remote file bytes through the range-response helper. Assets render inline; exports use attachment disposition. Missing evidence remains unavailable rather than being served as present.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Missing R2 evidence configuration throws; repository, storage and filesystem errors may also reject.

errors.name: HttpError 404
errors.description: Throws HTTP 404 for an unsupported group, unregistered export or unknown evidence. Registered evidence with no available instance instead throws HTTP 410.
